summary: Backend-only regression for v1.1 warehouse/auto-purchase separation. All 5 pytest cases pass against LIVE Firestore. Primary bug (historical invoice auto-purchase must NOT add warehouse stock), latent bug (force-editing an auto-generated linked purchase to destination=warehouse must STILL not sync stock), and both regression paths (manual purchase destination=warehouse DOES add stock; destination=direct_customer does NOT) all behave correctly. Every invoice/purchase created during the run was deleted; per-product on_hand and value returned to baseline. Live-DB concurrency observed on grand_total_value so assertions were scoped to the target product (P/P2) rather than the global total.

minor.issue: Deleting an invoice does NOT cascade-delete its auto-generated linked_purchase. The linked purchase remains in the payables ledger orphaned to a deleted invoice. Test compensates by explicitly deleting the linked purchase; production users would leak orphan auto-purchases.

Server accepts destination='warehouse' on an auto_generated / linked_invoice_id purchase and persists it. The stock sync correctly refuses, but exposing a value that the sync silently ignores is confusing — consider rejecting the update with 400 or coercing back to 'direct_customer'.

action_items: Consider cascade-deleting linked auto-purchase when its parent invoice is deleted (or reject invoice delete while linked purchase has payments).
Consider rejecting PUT /api/purchases updates that attempt to change destination on auto_generated purchases (or explicitly document that destination is ignored for them).
critical_code_review_comments: invoices.delete_invoice() only removes the invoice document; the linked auto-generated purchase (linked_invoice_id) is left behind — orphan risk on real data.

purchases.update_purchase() persists 'destination' even for auto_generated purchases; only the sync guard prevents stock corruption. A malicious/UI mistake will still show 'warehouse' in the ledger without adding stock — inconsistent state.
seed_data_creation: All test records deleted before finish: 2 invoices + 2 linked auto-purchases + 2 manual purchases, all removed. Warehouse per-product on_hand and value returned to captured baselines.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Runs against LIVE Firestore 'commercial-trading1'. Because live grand_total_value fluctuates during a test (other users transact), assert only against the per-product on_hand/value delta for the products under test — NOT the global grand_total. Always clean up both the invoice AND its linked_purchase_id explicitly; DELETE /api/invoices does not cascade. Use two DIFFERENT products (P, P2) so the historical-invoice test and the warehouse-purchase regression don't interfere.
rca_of_the_issue: Root fix verified: _sync_warehouse_stock() short-circuits when purchase.auto_generated or linked_invoice_id is set, and create_purchase only calls it when destination=='warehouse'. Historical invoice creation stamps destination='direct_customer', auto_generated=True, linked_invoice_id on the auto-purchase. Warehouse pool remains untouched in all invoice-linked paths, including the latent case of a forced PUT destination=warehouse. Regression paths behave: destination=warehouse writes a returned_stock lot (source=warehouse_purchase); DELETE removes the unused lot restoring baseline.
